title: Personalweather Metric1 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Weather-station readings (`weatherstation:reading`), daily weather-impact rollups (`personalweather:daily`), sleep correlation records (`personalweather:sleep`), step correlation records (`personalweather:steps`), mood correlation records (`personalweather:mood`).
app: Local weather-station readings correlated with personal sleep, steps, mood, and outdoor-activity summaries in Splunk via scripted inputs and daily rollups.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=personalweather:metric1 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in personalweather metric1 (1) events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme personalweather metric1 (1) records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It rates the unusually high or low value moments in your personalweather metric1 (1) history.
